metadata.description: Location for all resources.
Environment name suffix (e.g. dev, uat, prod).
Provision shared infrastructure without replacing the app while preparing its image/identity.
Provision runtime resource roles by default. Only skip after this installation has provisioned them successfully.
Entra directory ID for verified sign-in. Application memberships use separate tenant slugs.
Confidential web application registration ID with managed-identity federation configured.
Separate API resource application registration ID.
Server-owned Memberships and PlatformAdministrators. No credentials belong in this object.
Container image to deploy (e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io/docintel-api:latest).
Optional Azure Container Registry name for Managed Identity AcrPull.
Keep the legacy ACR path by default. False pulls an explicitly supplied public image without a registry or pull role.
Existing registry reuse leaves its SKU, networking, and authentication settings unchanged.
Registry pull role GUID. AcrPull is the default; ABAC registries require an explicitly supported role.
Runtime managed identity name. Empty uses uami-docintel-<environmentName>.
Use the existing runtime identity without redeploying it.
Existing Container Apps environment resource ID, including another resource group in this subscription. Skips environment and workspace creation.
Existing public HTTPS origin. Empty derives the origin from the selected app and environment.
Container App name. Empty uses ca-docintel-<environmentName>.
Storage account name. Empty uses the generated default.
Use the existing storage account without changing its root, Blob service, or Queue service configuration.
Existing required blob container names. Listed containers are not redeployed or reconfigured.
Existing required queue names. Listed queues are not redeployed or reconfigured.
Cosmos DB account name. Empty uses the generated default.
Use the existing Cosmos DB account without changing its root configuration.
Use the existing DocIntel database without changing its throughput or other database settings.
Existing required Cosmos container names. Listed containers retain indexing, TTL, and all other settings.
Key Vault name. Empty uses the generated default.
Use the existing Key Vault without changing its root configuration.
Use the existing docintel-identity key without changing its key material or rotation policy.
Foundry account name. Empty uses the generated default when an account is required.
Use the existing Foundry account without changing its identity, SKU, networking, or authentication settings.
Provision the requested model deployments. False leaves existing deployments unchanged.
Optional existing Microsoft Foundry Inference endpoint. When empty, a new Foundry (AIServices) resource is provisioned automatically.
Optional existing Azure OpenAI endpoint. Defaults to the provisioned Foundry resource when empty.
Optional existing Azure AI Translator endpoint. Defaults to the provisioned Foundry resource when empty.
Content Understanding Foundry resource root endpoint in a supported region. Empty uses the provisioned Foundry resource.
Foundry model deployments to provision automatically under the Foundry account.
